Definition: from G2532 and G1437; and (or even) if:--and (also) if (so much as), if but, at the least, though, yet.
BiblicalUsage: Kan is 'and if' — the word that hangs a promise on a condition. If I may touch but His clothes, I shall be whole; though he were dead, yet shall he live; and if it bear fruit, well.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that this little word carries the gospel's 'if': if I touch, if I believe, if it bears fruit — and the promise stands behind every one of them.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
